title: Good Stools
text: Good Stools. These stools look great. They are nice and very sleek. The rising and lowering lever works very well. My only concern is that they don't seem very securely grounded. Perhaps I'm just not very used to using stools, but they seem to require a bit more balance than I expected. I also have a complaint, though: I have a pet-peeve with companies that use nice chrome metal for their product only to then use cheap, fake chrome plastic for some of the detailing. These stools disappointingly did just that. Ugh.
